scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/hq && tsc -p apps/watcher && tsc -p apps/client && tsc -p scripts
scripts.cycles: madge --circular --extensions ts,tsx packages/core/src packages/hq/src apps/watcher/src apps/client/src bot/src scripts
scripts.clones: jscpd --min-lines 6 --min-tokens 50 --threshold 0 --reporters console --format typescript,javascript --ignore "**/node_modules/**,**/dist/**,**/.stryker-tmp/**,**/reports/**,**/records/**" packages apps bot scripts
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm cycles && pnpm clones && pnpm decisions && pnpm test
